definitions.partial: some sides of the outline are visible, others are not
definitions.strong: the whole outline follows something visible: wall, fence, hedge, kerb, building edge, a change of surface or crop
definitions.uncertain: cannot tell: shadow, blur or the image itself hides it
definitions.weak: almost none of the outline is visible: it crosses uniform ground, runs under canopy or through buildings
